title: SLA-aware Clause Mapping & Auto-Response Template Engine for Security Questionnaire and DPA Requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a prioritized intake flow and engine that maps incoming enterprise security/compliance asks (SOC2/ISO attestations, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA clauses, vendor questionnaires) to a small set of standardized clause templates and SLA tiers. The engine will: 1) classify request type and urgency; 2) assign an SLA tier (e.g., auto-response within 2 business days, legal review within 7 business days); 3) propose a prefilled response bundle (contract clauses, evidence links, review notes); and 4) surface a clear escalation path for out-of-scope or high-risk asks. Goal: reduce manual triage time for PM/SE/Legal by 60% for routine questionnaire responses and provide predictable SLAs for customers requesting compliance artifacts or DPAs.
acceptance_criteria: Classifier correctly tags request type (DPA, SOC2 evidence, ISO certificate, HIPAA inquiry, vendor questionnaire) with >=90% precision on a 200-sample holdout
SLA assignment rules defined and documented with at least three tiers and agreement from Legal and Support
Auto-response template engine can generate a draft response bundle (clause templates + links to evidence) for at least 70% of incoming questionnaire items
Integration points defined and a prototype implemented for: Confluence evidence lookup, Drive PDF attachments, and Zendesk/Support routing
Operational dashboard shows per-request SLA, current queue, and time-to-first-response for each tier
Playbook for manual override and escalation created and validated with Legal and Security teams
updates: 2026-02-21: Kickoff meeting with Product, Legal, Security, and Support. Agreed success metrics: reduction in manual triage time and predictable SLAs for customers.
2026-02-26: Design session with Legal — identified 12 canonical contract clauses commonly requested in DPAs and questionnaires. Legal volunteered clause owners for templating.
2026-03-02: Built initial mapping spreadsheet (questionary -> clause set -> evidence pointers). Engineering estimates a 2-week spike to wire up Confluence/Drive connectors.
2026-03-06: SE feedback: common customer asks include region-specific data residency confirmations; added a binary flag to intake for region impact.
2026-03-11: Prototype classifier (keyword + simple ML model) achieves 86% precision on internal sample. Need more labeled examples for long-tail questionnaire forms.
2026-03-12: Decided to scope MVP to: DPAs, SOC2 evidence bundles, and vendor questionnaire auto-responses. HIPAA-specific flow deferred to follow-up due to PHI handling concerns.

2026-03-14: Engineering kickoff for spike tickets created (ENG-42198 integration spike, ENG-42205 template storage schema). Legal requested ability to mark clauses as non-public; added to acceptance criteria.
